desc: Derive the contribution formula: answer = Σ_groups (sum of values in group g) × Σ_k k!(N−1−k)! · e_k^{(g)} mod p
Design e_k computation: per-group exclusion eg_k = e_k − x_g·eg_{k−1}, O(N) per group
Identify fatal flaw: per-copy insertion DP is O(N²) (4×10^10 ops) — must be replaced
Decide on numpy NTT (int64 safe since p² < 2^63) to compute E(t)=Π(1+x_g t)^{c_g} truncated to degree N−1; verified formula on N=3 → 1332

Implement numpy NTT (bit-reversal via vectorized shifts, per-level vectorized butterflies, cached rev/roots per size) and multiply the ≤6 group polys in increasing degree order, truncating to N coefficients
Implement group stats (c_d, value sums via arithmetic series), factorials, A_d polys via C(c_d,j)·x^j, per-group eg recurrence + w_k weighting, assemble answer
Handle edge cases: N=1 → 1, groups with c_d=0 skipped, truncation correctness (need e_0..e_{N−1} only)
Independently verify the full code: trace N=3 and N=1, audit NTT internals (rev/roots/butterfly/overflow/truncation), audit exclusion recurrence and final assembly, check runtime — no bugs found
Apply any fixes from verification and finalize the code block
